cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Admit What You Wanted
cards.instruction: Maneuver them into revealing which outcome they truly wanted before you explain your own stake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've snapped my folder shut like you. Decision made. Which job were you hoping I'd take?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My folder's empty. Both your unsigned contracts are still in yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, keeping it closed for now. The local job or the one abroad: what did you want?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Local. I don't want to move, but I didn't want that to choose for you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then keep your finger on the local contract while I open this. No changing your answer when you see mine.

reason: Replace the unsupported confidence overlay with a concrete misunderstood copied action that directs the same-holder Drive pursuit, with a responsive partner and an ending using B4.
